sources.title: Visas To Jordan
sources.officialityEvidence: The page identifies visitjordan.com as the official Jordan Tourism Board site and publishes its nationality-by-nationality arrival-visa table.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Andorra | Applicable | Visa can be obtained upon arrival, it will cost a total of 40 JOD.

policies.title: Andorran ordinary passports: Jordan visitor visa on arrival
policies.summary: Jordan's official Tourism Board table expressly makes a visa available to Andorran nationals on arrival for 40 JOD.
conditions: The listed visa is obtained on arrival and costs 40 JOD.
Jordan's table says all non-Jordanians must register on Gateway2Jordan before departure for a QR code.
Work, residence, special travel documents, entry-point limits, carrier checks and final admission remain separate.
